title: start_pipeline_success
description: Test starting the processing pipeline with a valid SRT URL. Expect a 200 response with status 'started' and the provided SRT URL.

title: start_pipeline_already_running
description: Test starting the pipeline when it is already running. Expect a 400 response with message 'Pipeline already running'.

title: stop_pipeline_success
description: Test stopping the processing pipeline when it is running. Expect a 200 response with status 'stopped'.

title: get_pipeline_status_running
description: Test retrieving the pipeline status when the pipeline is running. Expect a 200 response with a status object indicating running:true and including the HLS URL.

title: get_pipeline_status_stopped
description: Test retrieving the pipeline status when the pipeline is stopped. Expect a 200 response with a status object indicating running:false.

title: get_config_success
description: Test retrieving the current pipeline configuration. Expect a 200 response with the configuration object.

title: update_config_success
description: Test updating the pipeline configuration with valid partial data (e.g., changing log_level). Expect a 200 response with status 'updated' and the updated configuration object.

title: update_config_invalid_body
description: Test updating the pipeline configuration with invalid or malformed data. Expect a 400 response with validation error messages describing the invalid fields.

title: list_modules_success
description: Test listing all processing modules and their enabled/disabled status. Expect a 200 response with a list of modules and their states.

title: toggle_module_enable_disable
description: Test enabling or disabling a specific processing module by name with a valid boolean 'enabled' value. Expect a 200 response with the updated module state.
